title: Adam Mosseri says negativity around AI is ‘going to get worse’
hook_text: AI backlash is going to get worse
script:
Head of Instagram Adam Mosseri expects AI negativity to worsen.
He shared this perspective on the Colin and Samir podcast on October twenty-eighth.
Mosseri referenced college students booing tech CEOs at recent graduation ceremonies.
He stated this dislike is not limited to just young people or creatives.
Mosseri joined the show to discuss Instagram launching new widescreen video tools.
He noted that many people simply do not like AI right now.
Would you trust AI to curate your personal feed?

editor.one_line: Strong reporting, but visuals are repetitive and lack variety in pacing.
script_fixes: LINE 6: Replace 'many people simply do not like AI' with 'a broad segment of the public remains deeply skeptical of AI'.
visual_notes: line 1: Same photo held for too long across multiple frames.
line 3: Visuals are static text cards; needs footage of graduation protests or tech CEOs.
line 6: The Verge logo is irrelevant to the specific point about public sentiment.
